name: manifold-connector
description: Complete Manifold API workflows for ChatGPT through the shared Bratonien MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Manage a self-hosted Manifold instance through Bratonien MCP.
interface.longDescription: Exposes the complete named Manifold API surface present in the connected Manifold codebase at app-creation time, including projects, texts, resources, collections, ingestions, journals, reading groups, users, permissions, settings, analytics, uploads and administrative operations. Manifold credentials remain server-side in the internal connector and are never stored in this plugin.
defaultPrompt: Show the texts and resources in a Manifold project.
Manage a Manifold project for me.
